_comment: Maps common/alternate names used in the traveller's Excel sheet to the exact NAME / NAME_LONG / GEOUNIT / FORMAL_EN value used in the Natural Earth dataset. Keys are matched case-insensitively after whitespace/unicode normalization. This file is safe to edit by hand -- add an entry any time a name in an updated Excel file fails to match. Do not guess: only add an entry once you know which geographic entity it should resolve to.
_virgin_islands_resolution: Reconciled 2026: reconciliation.csv independently confirmed the workbook's bare 'Virgin Islands' entry (number 110) as the U.S. Virgin Islands specifically (not British) -- see its 'VI' row's note. Both the old bare text and the new CSV's explicit text now resolve to the same Natural Earth entity below. Never map either to 'British Virgin Is.' without equally explicit source evidence.
